profile.summary: Meghmani Organics Limited manufactures and sells pigments and agrochemicals in India and internationally. The company offers green and blue pigments, which are used in printing inks, paints and coatings, and plastics. It also offers agrochemical products comprising insecticides, which include acetamiprid, alphacypermethrin, bifenthrin, beta cyfluthrin, cyfluthrin, cypermethrin, deltamethrin, dinot
